BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2372.name: Soul Crunch
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A2372.effect:
When this card is sent to the Trash by the [Core Charge] of your Grandwalker Nexus, you can add it to the Hand.

[Flash]
Treat this card as colorless, and send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Reserve. Also, by sending one core from your exactly-named "Viole Mai -Mazoku Side-" to the Void, the cores that this effect would send to the Reserve are sent to the Trash instead.

DARKWURM-NOVA.name: The StarSlayerDragon Darkwurm-Nova X
DARKWURM-NOVA.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your "Nova X" Spirits can't brave (Separate the Brave if already braved), and are unaffected by opposing effects.

[Unleash: 2, Slayer] [LV2][LV3] Flash -
Once per turn, destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit. Or, once per game, you can put two cores from your Red/Purple Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, treat this Spirit as colorless, and destroy the Braves on every opposing Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4627.name: Godseeker SuperstarApostle Perdita
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4627.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Viole Mai" Grandwalker Nexus card, and a Cost 4 or more "Superstar" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol and an extra Purple symbol.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4630.name: Godseeker SuperstarApostle Tarvos
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4630.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Viole Mai" Grandwalker Nexus card and a Cost 4 or more "Superstar" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
All your Cost 3 or less "Superstar" family Spirits can't attack, and are unaffected by opposing effects.

SD51-009.name: Nova Draw
SD51-009.effect:
[zc] Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 10000 BP. After this effect resolves, by paying one cost, return this card to the Hand.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, by sending a core from any of your exactly-named "Viole Mai -Mazoku Side-" to the Void, draw a card.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8760.name: The BlackSuperstarApostle Blackwurm
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8760.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
If this Burst was activated when a "Superstar" family Spirit was depleted/destroyed, send two cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash, and when depletes, draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending a core from any opposing Spirit to the Trash, refresh this Spirit.

SD51-008.name: The Grandstar Laniakea
SD51-008.effect:
This card has "Superstar" family.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' color and symbol are as also treated as Purple.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Cost 5 or more "Superstar" family Spirits gain an extra Red symbol and are treated as being one level higher.

SIEGWURM-NOVA.name: The SupernovaDragon Siegwurm-Nova X
SIEGWURM-NOVA.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Astral Dragon & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending [Soul Core] to your Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
When [Advent] onto a "Superstar" family Spirit, put cores from the Void to your Life until your Life is five.

[Unleash: 4, Super] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 15000 BP. Also, by sending four cores from your Red/Purple Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, send up to two opposing Lives to the Void.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12924.name: The SuperstarApostle Cordelia
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12924.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return a Cost 6 or less "Superstar" family card from your Trash to your Hand. When you've done so, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Besides [Soul Core], send any number of cores from your Trash to this Spirit. When this effect puts four cores or more, you can [Advent] a "Superstar" family Spirit card from your Hand onto this Spirit, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12926.name: The SuperstarApostle Spitzer Dragon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12926.effect:
This card in Trash can't be returned to the Hand/deck, and can't be switched in places.

When the opponent declares a Burst activation, you can pay one cost to immediately summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, discard one of those Bursts, and either put two cores from the Void to this Spirit or + cores to any Grandwalker Nexuses you control, in any way you like.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and when it destroys, refresh this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13281.name: The TwinkleStarNinthApostle Phoebe
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13281.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Astral Dragon & Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Trash. Or, you can send two cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13285.name: The TwinkleStarThirdApostle Ganymede
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13285.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Astral Dragon & Cost 3 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending [Soul Core] to your Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. Also, when this Spirit [advents], you can summon one of this Spirit's pre-advent cards by paying one cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card. Also, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13534.name: The WhiteSuperstarApostle Whitewurm
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13534.effect:
When you [Advent], you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
By destroying an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit, draw a card. The effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

SD51-CP01.name: Viole Mai -Mazoku Side-
SD51-CP01.effect:
[Core Charge: (Astral Dragon/Avatar & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Red.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Send a core from any opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Trash.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When the opponent uses a Magic card, before its effect activates, by banishing four "Superstar" family cards from your Trash, immediately negate that effect.
